name: NextOS Runner
summary: Run your NextOS agents on your own computer instead of the cloud: real files in a folder you choose, your hardware, no cloud CPU charged.

seo.title: NextOS Runner - run NextOS agents on your own machine

faq.q: What does it need on my computer?
faq.a: Node.js 18 or newer and a folder for the agent's file tools. To run Claude Code or Codex jobs on your subscription, that client must be installed and signed in on the same machine.

faq.q: Can it touch files outside the folder I chose?
faq.a: No. File tools are confined to that folder, and shell commands run only if they are on the allowlist you pass with --allow.
The runner is free and open source. A job uses your computer's CPU and your own AI provider key or subscription, never cloud sandbox hours.
